dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Xiān xǐ xīhóngshì, zài yòng dāo qiē.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Wǒ lái qiē! Dāo zài nǎr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Qiēwán le. Jīdàn yào zhǔ ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 哈哈，不是！你看，用这个炒。
dialogue.reading: Hāhā, bù shì! Nǐ kàn, yòng zhège chǎo.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 好！我学会了，明天我自己做！
dialogue.reading: Hǎo! Wǒ xuéhuì le, míngtiān wǒ zìjǐ zuò!
